tasks.title: Amphibian Declines
paras: Amphibians are the only group of animals on the earth that spend part of their lives on land and part in the water. Dramatic declines in amphibian populations have been noted since the late 1980s from locations all over the world, and amphibian declines are thus perceived to be one of the most critical threats to global biodiversity. Among the possible causes for this phenomenon is pollution. Scientific data strongly suggest that certain kinds of pollution are at least partially responsible. One of the sources of pollution is acid precipitation.

The acid from precipitation accumulates in and around lakes and ponds where amphibians live. Concentrations of acid are the highest in the spring, which puts newly laid amphibian eggs at risk. Melting acid snow can produce an acid pulse, which is a sudden release of acid into the water.It acts like a dose of poison. Studies show that even slightly acidic water can kill the eggs of the frogs and toads or cause deformed tadpoles. Acid precipitation has been blamed for the disappearance of the tiger salamanders from parts of the Colorado Rockies.

Some amphibian species, such as the New Jersey Pine Barrens frog, thrive in water with high acid content. Scientists offer an explanation for this exception: because the level of acid has been the same for many years, the frogs have managed to adapt to conditions that would kill other species.

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 正确答案：(D) Pollution's effect on amphibians 正确答案分析： 全文围绕"污染（尤其是酸雨）对两栖动物的负面影响"展开： 首段指出两栖动物种群减少与污染相关（污染是可能原因之一）； 后两段具体分析酸雨如何伤害两栖动物卵和幼体，并引用蝾螈灭绝案例。 选项分析： A 未提及两栖动物生长过程； B 酸雨仅是污染的一种，非全文核心； C 生物多样性威胁是背景，非具体论述对象。

questions.stem: The word “declines” is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 正确答案：(B) decreases 原文定位："Dramatic declines in amphibian populations"（两栖动物种群数量急剧...）。 正确答案分析：语境线索：后文提到"最严重的生物多样性威胁之一"，且与"increases（增加）"相反，故为"减少"。 选项分析： A 增加（反义）； C 吸收（无关）； D 爆炸（通常指人口激增，此处不符语境）。

questions.stem: According to the text, in which season are the concentrations of acid the highest?
questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 正确答案：(A) Spring 正确答案分析："Concentrations of acid are the highest in the spring"（酸浓度在春季最高）。 补充机制：春季酸雪融化形成"酸脉冲（acid pulse）"，突然释放高浓度酸。

questions.stem: According to the text, what damage can the acid rain bring?

options.B: It can kill the New Jersey Pine Barrens frog.
options.C: It can cause the disappearance of the tiger salamanders.

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 正确答案：(C) It can cause the disappearance of the tiger salamanders. 原文定位："Acid precipitation has been blamed for the disappearance of the tiger salamanders from parts of the Colorado Rockies." 正确答案分析：酸雨被认为是科罗拉多落基山脉部分地区虎蝾螈消失的原因。 选项分析： A 原文说酸雨致畸"蝌蚪（tadpoles）"而非成体蟾蜍； B 新泽西蛙是例外，适应高酸环境； D "混合污染物"未提及。

questions.stem: Why does the author mention the New Jersey Pine Barrens frog?

options.A: To show the acid rain has caused great damage to the amphibians
options.B: To give an example of species that have disappeared
options.D: To show the frogs cannot adapt to the environment

questions.analysis: 题型：目的题 正确答案：(C) To bring out an exception 原文逻辑：在论述酸雨普遍危害后，用"However"式转折引出该蛙类："Some amphibian species... thrive in high acid"（某些物种在高酸环境中繁衍），旨在说明存在适应性例外。 作者意图：强调污染影响的复杂性（多数物种受害 vs. 少数物种适应）。 选项分析： A 该案例体现"生存"而非"破坏"； B 该蛙未灭绝； D 为了证明青蛙不能适应环境错误。
